newsitem.title: USA: Essex acquires West Coast properties.
newsitem.headline: Essex acquires West Coast properties.

text.p: Essex Properties Trust Inc on Friday said it acquired multifamily residential properties on the U.S. West Coast for $30.65 million.
The company said the acquisition comprised three apartment communities -- two in the Seattle area and one in Orange County, Calif.
It said it bought Wilshire Promenade, a 128-unit apartment community with 11,836 square feet of space located in downtown Fullerton, Calif., for $10.25 million.
Laurels at Mill Creek, a 164-unit community in Mill Creek, Washington, cost $7.6 million, while 264-unit Brighton Ridge Apartments in Renton, Washington was $12.8 million, it said.
